tracking: ADR-0360 slice 2 (lane E41): API-only under the lane brief rule 3; the EDR connection, signal and isolation screens are requested on #453 (Governed Designer)

gaps.POST /v1/discovery/sources/:sourceId/edr: creates a read-only EDR connection (credential sealed, never returned; webhook secret shown once; audited)
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/sources/:sourceId/edr-: lists a source's EDR connections (no secrets)
gaps.PUT /v1/edr-connections/:connectionId/se: enables or disables an EDR connection, and turns isolation on (settings_relax step-up, audited) or off
gaps.POST /v1/edr-connections/:connectionId/s: pulls the EDR's device risk and open alerts into the device signals now
gaps.GET /v1/discovery/sources/:sourceId/edr-: lists each enrolled device's latest EDR risk and alert counts (pseudonyms only, paged)
gaps.POST /v1/edr-connections/:connectionId/i: asks to isolate one device through the EDR (waits for a second admin)
gaps.GET /v1/edr-isolations: lists isolation requests with their declared lifecycle and allowed next steps
gaps.POST /v1/edr-isolations/:requestId/:even: approves or rejects an isolation or a release (another admin, fresh step-up; audited)
